subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value: IMAGE-WIDE RESIDUAL-FAMILY CENSUS, measured 2026-09-01 over 257 objects (50 raw pre-WebFrank bodies + 207 unpinned) against the dtk-extracted targets. 421 paired functions are non-identical. Partition: OTHER 133 fns / 53 TUs; LENGTH (instruction-count delta) 129 / 41; RECOLOR (every differing word same opcode and same operand shape, registers only) 83 / 37; MIXED-LIVEZERO 55 / 28; PERMUTE (instruction multisets equal, order differs) 13 / 11; LIVEZERO (whole residual is live-zero sites) 4 / 2; LIVEZERO+RECOLOR 4 / 4. THE LIVE-ZERO FAMILY therefore spans 63 functions across ~30 TUs and 111 individual sites. ITS DIRECTION SPLIT IS 56 target-copies/ours-remats vs 55 target-remats/ours-copies -- a 50.5/49.5 coin flip across dozens of unrelated functions. That symmetry is the decisive evidence that the choice is an allocator state function and not a source property or a global compiler-flag default: a source-side or flag-side cause would be directionally biased, and no single toggle can move both directions at once. It independently corroborates and extends claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source.20260831.v1, whose bidirectionality evidence was two functions; this is 111 sites. PINNED vs UNPINNED: RECOLOR 78 pinned / 5 unpinned; PERMUTE 9 / 4; LIVEZERO 4 / 0; LIVEZERO+RECOLOR 1 / 3; MIXED-LIVEZERO 9 / 46; OTHER 28 / 105; LENGTH 0 / 129. Read that MIXED-LIVEZERO row: the live-zero family is roughly six times larger than the rule population that currently serves it, so a general live-zero proof mode has a real unserved payoff set, whereas the recolor class is already almost fully pinned (78 of 83). RECOLOR FINGERPRINT (tools/gdl/composed_census/cv_recolor_shape.py): of the 83 pure-RECOLOR functions, 46 induce a well-defined injective register map (33 GPR-only, 9 FPR-only, the rest mixed); 37 do not (the differing words disagree on the map, i.e. they are not a single consistent renaming). Among the 46, the cycle structure is dominated by SMALL permutations -- 18 plain transpositions, 7 three-cycles -- and 32 of 46 involve a CONTIGUOUS block of register numbers. Representative maps: {r6->r7, r7->r6}, {r29->r30, r30->r29}, {r3->r4, r4->r3}, {r26->r27, r27->r26}. Adjacent transpositions of contiguous allocation-order slots are the signature of a shifted register-selection ORDER inside one allocator, not of different code. METHOD CAVEAT for anyone re-running this: the first revision of the classifier normalized only `r\d+` and silently filed every FPR-only renaming (e.g. mb_particle::getSinCos) under OTHER, undercounting RECOLOR by 29 functions; normalize BOTH register files.
